log.msg: Started: reading the audio/Whisper readmes and code before writing the class architecture.

Class architecture written: audio/Whisper/doc/demo.md (WhisperDemo extends View + Detail; reuses WhisperLog, WhisperLogRows, Dictate, JSONL, InspectCard). Worktree qf-7. Log page will become the same demo (record + replay, never empty).

decision.what: One raw Whisper store: the repo day file ai/whisper/<date>.jsonl via WhisperLog.record(), written by Dictate.log_whisper() on every surface; the Servex whisper-raw post retires.
decision.alternative: Keep Servex whisper-raw (single writer, outside the repo, live() cannot tail it), or the voice session's own record in the dated store (the owner's direction; waits on core/Item/Dated slice 2).
decision.why: The demo must tail it with JSONL.live(), and the table already reads the day file.

decision.what: Store revised per the owner (19:20): one temporary bucket file ai/whisper/bucket.jsonl, no date/index/query code; New session appends a {src:'bucket',kind:'new'} marker and the demo shows only lines after it.
decision.alternative: A new file per session (needs a pointer to the current file) or the dated sessions store via core/Item/Dated slice 2 (later home).
decision.why: Simplest one-file tail with JSONL.live(); removes the date code WhisperLog.path() had.

decision.what: Rows are drawn by WhisperDemo itself, not ext/DataGrid.
decision.why: This is a tail that follows the newest line with rows that open inline into a drill-down; DataGrid is a sortable, windowed table/rail and would fight both.

log.msg: Headless fake-mic proof passed: 7 rows (6 guesses incl. one amend, 1 final replacing all 6), drill-down with segments and word confidence, maximize, Class tab. Shots in shots/. Fixing max z-index, row numbers, 400 chip.
